intro.text: Highprince Dalinar Kholin's bridgelord on the Shattered Plains.

items.text: Havarah was in charge of the large chull-drawn bridges Dalinar's army used on its plateau runs against the Parshendi.

appearance.text: A short man with some Herdazian ancestry, shown by his dark, crystalline fingernails, though he doesn't wear a sparkflicker.
